description_short: Join rare-earth MOSLED host matrices from the performance table (Table 5) with their corresponding ALD process recipes from the rare-earth ALD process overview (Table 3), returning host, process material, EQE, metal precursor, co-reactant, GPC, and deposition temperature.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

tables_modeled.label: Table 3
tables_modeled.description: Overview of rare-earth ALD processes (materials, metal precursors, co-reactants, growth per cycle (GPC), and deposition temperatures).

tables_modeled.label: Table 5
tables_modeled.description: Performance characteristics of Er3+-based MOSLED devices (host matrices, annealing temperatures, EQE, power efficiency, threshold voltage, emission lifetime τ, and operational lifetime OLT).

join_strategy.description: The query joins MOSLED host matrices (Table 5) with ALD process materials (Table 3) by normalizing their labels and stripping non-alphanumeric characters.
steps: From Table 5 comparison R1469991, retrieve host matrices via P180031 and their labels (?hostLabel).
From Table 3 comparison R1471077, retrieve ALD materials via P9071 and their labels (?mat3Label).
For each side, construct a join key by lowercasing and removing non-alphanumeric characters (keys ?key5, ?key3).
Filter on equality of these keys (FILTER(?key5 = ?key3)) to link ALD process rows to MOSLED hosts.
join_strategy.limitations: The label-based join may miss matches if naming conventions differ strongly (e.g., alternative abbreviations or spelling variants not normalized by the simple regex).

output_shape.description: Each row corresponds to one joined (host matrix, ALD process) pair with associated EQE and process parameters.
columns: matrix: normalized name of the MOSLED host material (from Table 5)
process_material: ALD material entry from Table 3 matched to the host
eqe: external quantum efficiency as stored in Table 5
metal_precursor: human-readable label of precursor 1 (P180042) when available
co_reactant: human-readable co-reactant label (from P180043) when available
gpc: reported growth per cycle (P180041) from Table 3

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The query operationalizes the question 'For each luminescent MOSLED host material, what ALD recipe was used to deposit it, and what EQE does the resulting device achieve?' By joining process-level data (precursor chemistry, GPC, thermal budget) with device-level performance (EQE), it enables analysis of how specific ALD chemistries relate to MOSLED efficiency, without manually cross-referencing two separate tables in the original review.
